need a email wrote to Rhonda at the diner for our christmas breakfast, we do it every year at her place. her emails from last year are in there and Dwayne sent me the list. this year is kind of a big one cause Earl is retiring so we want to do something for him but he cant find out. I type slow so just put it together like I would and leave it in drafts, I'll look it over tonite before I send it make it a new email, not a reply to last year's thread. ask about all the numbers and food bits below too, and the door and coffee.

- Saturday Dec 19, back room, 7am same as always. if 19th is no good then the 12th
- 24 counting Earl and Carol
- Lonnie on a walker since his hip, needs the side door with no steps
- Patsy cant do eggs, oatmeal or pancakes or whatever she's got
- last year coffee ran out about 8:15, urn quit. Rhonda felt bad about it
- Earl drove 31 years, last day is the 18th, the day before
- her cinnamon rolls are better than any cake, Earl loves them
- $11 a head was fair, fine if its up a little
- ask can we bring a cake from Sugarcreek or just do a big tray of her cinnamon rolls w a candle
- separate checks again
- ask about a backup coffee pot, nicely
- I'll get her the final count by the Wednesday before like she wants

(About me: school bus driver, 62, Dayton, Ohio. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

[email to dispatch, 2026-02-03T05:48:00] Morning, the heater on 31 is out again. Third time since Christmas. Kids are sitting there in coats and hats and the little ones are complaining there feet are cold and I don't blame them. I told the shop on Friday and Ray said it was the blend door but I don't think they fixed nothing because its doing the same exact thing. Can I get a spare til its fixed for real? I don't care which one long as the heat works. 27 would be fine I drove it before. Also the wiper on the drivers side is streaking, not a big deal but while they got it in there. Thanks, Gary
[email to church office, 2026-03-11T19:20:00] Hi Linda, I can do the fryer again this friday same as last week, I'll be there by 3:30 once I drop my afternoon kids. Couple things. We ran low on the tartar sauce right around 6 and people noticed, so maybe get the big jugs from Gordons not the little ones. And the one fryer on the end is running hot I think the thermostat is going, the fish was coming out dark before it was done in the middle. I turned it down but somebody should look at it before Lent is over. Bob said he could bring his if we need it. Otherwise it went good, I heard we did 340 dinners which is the most I remember. Tell the youth group kids they did a good job on the tables they hustled. Gary

Is that covered since it was just put on? I can bring it in any day after 9 since I'm off for summer, school don't start til the 19th. Let me know what day is good, I'd rather not wait til it goes flat on the highway. Thanks Gary Hollins
